title: Light feijoada with pork tenderloin and kale
steps: Chop the onion and 2 garlic cloves, dice the pork and slice the chouriço.
Brown the meat and chouriço in 1 tsp oil, add the onion and garlic and fry for 3 minutes.
Add the rinsed beans and stock and simmer covered for 30 minutes, mashing a few beans.
Cut the kale into fine strips and fry with the remaining garlic in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes; cook the rice.
Serve the feijoada with rice, kale and orange segments.
